## Purpose
Development and test dependencies: the runtime requirements plus pytest.

## Settings that matter
`-r requirements.txt` and `pytest>=8`.

## Read by
`pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`, before running `tool-service/tests`.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
The sandbox libraries (`sandbox_requirements.txt`) are not included. Tests that need pandas or numpy in generated code may need them installed.

## How to rebuild this file
Two lines.
